messages.author: fa7f2c753543d217
messages.subject: Error using FIML
parts:
Hello,

I can't figure out why I can't run my models using FIML. When I try to add missing='fiml' to any bit of code that is working, I get the same error. 

This is some example code:
lavaan_m6 <- '
AUDIT~Sex+Greek+any_sport+race_5_nh+DOSPERT_health+general_risk_av+binge_av+one_av+absolute+relative
'
mlav6 <- sem(lavaan_m6, data=data2)
fit <- sem(mlav6, data=data2, missing='fiml', fixed.x=FALSE)
summary(fit, rsquare=TRUE, standardized=TRUE)

The error is:
 Error in tcrossprod(Yp[[p]]$MY - Mu[var.idx]) : object 'Mu.hat' not found

Any insight? Thank you

messages.author: 5abdb409f213d464
messages.subject: Re: Error using FIML
parts:
You cannot pass a fitted lavaan object (mlav6) to the sem function. The latter is simply a wrapper function. Anything else would be new to me. Your problem has certainly nothing to do with fiml.

messages.subject: Re: Error using FIML
parts:
To be specific:

The second sem() call should use lavaan_m6 as its object, same as the first one does--not mlav6.
